```yaml
name: Performance Benchmark

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  benchmark:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout PR branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: pr-checkout

      - name: Checkout main branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          path: main-checkout

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          cd pr-checkout
          npm ci
          cd ../main-checkout
          npm ci

      - name: Build PR branch
        run: |
          cd pr-checkout
          npm run build

      - name: Build main branch
        run: |
          cd main-checkout
          npm run build

      - name: Run benchmark for PR branch
        id: pr_benchmark
        run: |
          cd pr-checkout
          echo "Running benchmark for PR branch..."
          # Warmup runs
          for i in {1..2}; do
            echo "Warmup run $i"
            npm run pack --silent
          done
          
          # Measured runs
          times=()
          for i in {1..5}; do
            echo "Measured run $i"
            start=$(date +%s.%N)
            npm run pack --silent
            end=$(date +%s.%N)
            duration=$(echo "$end - $start" | bc)
            times+=($duration)
          done
          
          # Calculate median
          sorted_times=($(printf '%s\n' "${times[@]}" | sort -n))
          len=${#sorted_times[@]}
          if (( len % 2 == 1 )); then
            median=${sorted_times[$((len/2))]}
          else
            mid1=${sorted_times[$((len/2-1))]}
            mid2=${sorted_times[$((len/2))]}
            median=$(echo "scale=6; ($mid1 + $mid2) / 2" | bc)
          fi
          
          echo "pr_time=$median" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Run benchmark for main branch
        id: main_benchmark
        run: |
          cd main-checkout
          echo "Running benchmark for main branch..."
          # Warmup runs
          for i in {1..2}; do
            echo "Warmup run $i"
            npm run pack --silent
          done
          
          # Measured runs
          times=()
          for i in {1..5}; do
            echo "Measured run $i"
            start=$(date +%s.%N)
            npm run pack --silent
            end=$(date +%s.%N)
            duration=$(echo "$end - $start" | bc)
            times+=($duration)
          done
          
          # Calculate median
          sorted_times=($(printf '%s\n' "${times[@]}" | sort -n))
          len=${#sorted_times[@]}
          if (( len % 2 == 1 )); then
            median=${sorted_times[$((len/2))]}
          else
            mid1=${sorted_times[$((len/2-1))]}
            mid2=${sorted_times[$((len/2))]}
            median=$(echo "scale=6; ($mid1 + $mid2) / 2" | bc)
          fi
          
          echo "main_time=$median" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Calculate difference
        id: calculate_diff
        run: |
          pr_time=${{ steps.pr_benchmark.outputs.pr_time }}
          main_time=${{ steps.main_benchmark.outputs.main_time }}
          
          diff=$(echo "scale=6; $pr_time - $main_time" | bc)
          diff_percent=$(echo "scale=2; ($diff / $main_time) * 100" | bc)
          
          # Format with proper sign
          if (( $(echo "$diff > 0" | bc -l) )); then
            diff_formatted="+$diff"
            diff_percent_formatted="+$diff_percent"
          else
            diff_formatted="$diff"
            diff_percent_formatted="$diff_percent"
          fi
          
          echo "diff_seconds=$diff_formatted" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "diff_percent=$diff_percent_formatted" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "pr_time=$pr_time" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "main_time=$main_time" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create benchmark comment
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          message: |
            ### Performance Benchmark Results
            
            | | Time |
            |---|---:|
            | PR branch | ${{ steps.calculate_diff.outputs.pr_time }}s |
            | main branch | ${{ steps.calculate_diff.outputs.main_time }}s |
            | **Diff** | **${{ steps.calculate_diff.outputs.diff_seconds }}s (${{ steps.calculate_diff.outputs.diff_percent }}%)** 
            
            <!-- BENCHMARK_RESULT -->
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          comment-tag: BENCHMARK_RESULT
          mode: replace
          pr-number: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
```
